name: photo-marquee-section
purpose: The office band of the careers page: a horizontal section title over a framed strip of photographs of varied aspect ratios that scrolls continuously and pauses on hover, on focus or from its pause control; the loop is the one `marquee` runs on. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'photo-marquee-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `module`, `module-header` and `registration-frame`.
useWhen: Use PhotoMarqueeSection for a decorative moving strip of photos.
To show a place or a team in pictures without a grid.
related: `recognition-marquee-section` — the sibling strip of quotes with the same loop.
bestPractices: Give every photo its `width` and `height` so the strip reserves each slot before the picture loads.
Leave `duration` at `0` to let the strip pace itself (ten seconds per photo).

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the horizontal section title as its `h2`; the band renders no header when empty.

props.name: descriptionWidth
props.doc: Width the description is capped at: `narrow` or `wide`.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the scrolling region.

props.name: duration
props.doc: Seconds one loop of the strip takes; `0` paces it at ten seconds per photo.

props.name: photos
props.doc: The photographs, in order; each is `{ src, alt, width, height }`.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.
